search_results.title: I Tried the Controversial Manicure Taking Over TikTok-My Nails Look Unreal
search_results.description: In the article, a beauty editor explores the increasingly viral Russian manicure, a technique gaining popularity on TikTok despite being controversial and banned in some U.S. states. Unlike traditional methods, Russian manicures are dry, avoiding water and acetone, and rely on electric files to remove previous polish and meticulously clean and cut the cuticles. A key feature is the “polish alignment” process, which creates an aesthetically perfect nail arch and longer-lasting results—up to five weeks compared to two to three with gel manicures. The procedure is more time-consuming, lasting around two hours, and requires highly trained professionals, like those at Gilded Ritual spa in Manhattan. Despite warnings from dermatological associations against cutting cuticles due to potential infection risks, the editor found the experience safe, thorough, and impressive when performed by a skilled technician. She noted that her final result garnered more compliments than any previous manicure, underscoring the technique’s aesthetic appeal.
